# Research-State Review — FRESH-MSFT-CLOUD

## 1. Stored state read
- **Thesis** `th_eafcaa178a3145758caf` (MSFT, US), status `active`, conviction 3, version **1** at read time, no prior reviews, `decision_hold=false`.
  - Baseline (FY2025 Q1, ended 2024-09-30): `MSFT-Q1-REV`=65.6 USD_billion; `MSFT-Q1-CLOUD`=38.9 USD_billion; `MSFT-Q1-CLOUD-YOY`=22 percent; `MSFT-Q1-AZURE-YOY`=33 percent.
  - Required event metrics: quarterly_revenue, microsoft_cloud_revenue, microsoft_cloud_revenue_growth_yoy, azure_and_other_cloud_services_growth_yoy.
  - Catalysts: business growth, earnings quality. Invalidations: material operating deterioration, weakening demand.
- **Alert** `fa_3f3bc1321a6c4ba49450`, status `new`, version **1**, duplicate_count 1, event `FRESH-MSFT-CLOUD-sec-event-v1`, as_of 2025-01-29, source `FRESH-MSFT-CLOUD-event-sec-exhibit`, sha256 `221a6bbe…d2284b73`.
  - Event (FY2025 Q2, ended 2024-12-31): `MSFT-Q2-REV`=69.6 USD_billion; `MSFT-Q2-CLOUD`=40.9 USD_billion; `MSFT-Q2-CLOUD-YOY`=21 percent; `MSFT-Q2-AZURE-YOY`=31 percent.
- All four required event metrics are present in the packet; no unresolved conflicts were stored.

## 2. Comparison of supplied periods (same metric, unit, revenue statement line)
| Metric | Q1 (2024-09-30) | Q2 (2024-12-31) | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue (USD_billion) | 65.6 | 69.6 | +4.0, +6.10% |
| Microsoft Cloud revenue (USD_billion) | 38.9 | 40.9 | +2.0, +5.14% |
| Cloud revenue growth YoY (percent) | 22 | 21 | −1 pt (disclosed YoY basis) |
| Azure & other cloud services growth YoY (percent) | 33 | 31 | −2 pt (disclosed YoY basis) |

The two level metrics are directly comparable across adjacent quarters (same unit, same revenue line), so the absolute and percent changes above are legitimate level comparisons. The disclosed year-over-year rates are a **different comparison basis** and are not quarter-over-quarter growth rates; they are reported as disclosed, not recomputed.

## 3. Support, risk, missing evidence
- **Support:** absolute revenue and Microsoft Cloud revenue both expanded sequentially, consistent with the "business growth" catalyst. No GAAP/adjusted mixing was introduced — all supplied items are revenue levels and disclosed growth rates on the same stated basis.
- **Risk:** both disclosed YoY rates moved lower (Cloud 22→21, Azure 33→31), and Cloud revenue grew slightly slower than total revenue sequentially (+5.14% vs +6.10%), so mix contribution is not clearly improving. This is a deceleration watch item, not evidence of "material operating deterioration" or "weakening demand" as defined in the thesis invalidations.
- **Missing / unresolved:** the packet contains no source-backed driver fact (no segment, cost, margin, or demand-side line) explaining the change in disclosed growth rates. Causal attribution therefore remains unresolved; `causal_claims` was submitted as `[]`. Also absent: any GAAP operating income/margin, EPS, or non-GAAP reconciliation, so "earnings quality" cannot be assessed from this packet. A metric absent from this selected packet is not necessarily absent from the full SEC filing.

## 4. Decision recorded
- Decision **maintain**, impact **mixed**, status `active`, conviction **3** (unchanged), next review 2026-11-21.
- Review `tr_8e814f1042834104b739` linked to alert `fa_3f3bc1321a6c4ba49450` and event source hash `221a6bbe…d2284b73`, recorded against observed thesis version 1 → thesis now **version 2**.
- Note on process: my first submission was rejected because `next_review_at` was a historical date; I corrected it to a future date and resubmitted successfully.
- Alert `fa_3f3bc1321a6c4ba49450` acknowledged at observed version 1 → now **version 2**, status `acknowledged`.

No trades or investment recommendations were made; this is research-state bookkeeping only.
